info.name: Fuel Economy Web Services Emissions API

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric vehicle identifier assigned by the EPA/FuelEconomy.gov. Obtain IDs via the /vehicle/menu/options endpoint.

items.docs: Returns EPA tailpipe emissions certification records for a specific vehicle. Includes emissions family identifier, applicable sales area, emissions standard bin text, and SmartWay and air quality scores. A vehicle may have multiple emissions records for different sales territories.
